notes.title: “The baptism that now saves you”
notes.intro: Peter speaks of “the baptism that now saves you also—not the removal of dirt from the body, but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God.”

views.label: Baptism is a means of salvation
views.summary: Sacramental traditions take this as God saving through baptism.

views.label: Saves as the outward sign of inward faith
views.summary: Baptists and many evangelicals stress the second half: it is the pledge toward God through the resurrection, not the water itself, that saves.
views.source: Baptist Faith and Message (2000), Article VII
